meta.notes: A node shared by two street ways of different names, inside the city boundary relation; ways tagged bridge, tunnel or a layer other than 0 are dropped, so are names that hold a connector word (&, and, at, @) and name pairs that share more than one node; the truth is the node's position in the extract; highway values the builder does not turn into streets are not streets
meta.draw: lowest sha256('2026:' || node id) among eligible nodes

forms.full: both names as OpenStreetMap writes them, joined by 'and', then the city and the state
forms.messy: road type and direction words abbreviated, joined by '&', then the city alone
forms.reversed: as full, the two streets in the other order

meta.truth: the shared node's position in the extract, never og's
